title: FM27 Tactics — Football Manager 27 Tactic Index
description: FM27 tactics: what Tactical Tweaks change in Football Manager 27, the checks before you download a tactic, and the shapes worth testing from 29 October 2026.
meta: Football Manager 27 tactic index — opens when the Launch Preview lands on 29 October 2026.
body:
FM27 ships on 10 November 2026. Until players have the build in their hands there is no tactic meta to index — only marketing. This page is the working index for that job: what changes in the tactic layer, how a tactic gets listed here, and which shapes are worth testing first.

The free Launch Preview runs 29 October to 3 November, so the first real data arrives a week and a half before launch.

What FM27 changes in the tactic layer

Sports Interactive's published feature posts name three changes that affect how you set a team up:

  • Tactical Tweaks — instructions delivered from the touchline, mid-match, aimed at gaps you spot in the opposition shape.
  • New player instructions — finer control over how the team attacks the box.
  • Tactical Effectiveness — SI's feedback layer for whether the shape you picked is doing its job.

Those three push the game away from "import a tactic, press continue". If instructions are meant to change at 60 minutes, a tactic file is a starting shape, not a finished plan.

Six checks before you download anyone's tactic

  • Mentality and pressing — gegenpress, control and counter are different jobs. A counter tactic advertised as "best" usually means "best with a mid-table side".
  • Tempo and passing length — high tempo with short passing and high tempo with direct balls are different teams.
  • Shape plus roles — a 4-2-3-1 with two attacking full-backs is not the 4-2-3-1 that won someone's league.
  • The squad it was tested with — a title-winning side proves the tactic works with elite players, and nothing else.
  • Patch number — FM patches change match behaviour. A tactic tested in the Launch Preview is a preview tactic.
  • Sample size — ten games is a streak; a season across two leagues is evidence.
Listing rule for this page: no tactic goes in without patch number, league, seasons tested and squad tier. If an author cannot supply those four, the tactic stays out however good the screenshot looks.

Shapes worth testing first

These are starting points, not recommendations. Each one asks a different question of the FM27 match engine:

  • 4-2-3-1 high press — the default modern shape. The question is whether the double pivot still covers the space behind two attacking full-backs.
  • 4-3-3 possession — slow build, high line, one holding midfielder. Tests whether passing patterns still break a mid-block.
  • 5-3-2 / 4-4-2 low block — deep, narrow, counter through two strikers. The cheapest way to survive a stronger league, and the first thing to break when a match engine changes.
  • 3-4-2-1 / 3-4-3 — three centre-backs, wing-backs high. Tests whether the wide areas still decide matches.

What the FM27 tactic index will contain

From 29 October this page becomes a list, not an essay. Each entry carries: tactic name, shape, mentality, pressing style, tempo, passing length, patch version, author, test league, seasons tested, squad tier, and the date it was last checked.

The field list follows the FM Scout tactic index, which shows those attributes next to each download — a format FM players already know how to read. Entries will be grouped three ways: elite (tested with top-six squads), underdog (mid-table and below) and lower league (semi-pro and amateur). A tactic that wins the Champions League is not the tactic that gets a League Two side promoted.

Dates that matter for FM27 tactics

  • 29 October 2026, 18:00 GMT — Launch Preview opens free on Steam, Epic, the Microsoft Store, Xbox Game Pass and PC Game Pass, every game mode included.
  • 3 November 2026, 18:00 GMT — the free window closes. Pre-purchase at 10% off keeps preview access until launch.
  • 10 November 2026 — full launch: PC/Mac, FM27 Console on Xbox and PS5, FM27 Mobile on Netflix, FM27 Touch on Apple Arcade.
  • First post-launch patch — the patch that meaningfully changes match behaviour is when launch-week tactics need re-testing.

What this page will not claim

No "best tactic" label without a test season behind it. No win-rate screenshot from a save the author cannot describe. No FM26 tactic relabelled as an FM27 tactic: every entry states the patch it was tested on.
